text:
lia (marketing): hey @eng-runtime — prepping the webinar next Tues. Need a focused bench rerun and validated artifacts we can cite. Ask: hotpath cohort + long-context tail + per-request p99 breakdown + raw traces for 100 requests. Also need checksummed request file and the exact run command we can paste into docs. Ping @suresh

suresh: we can take this. couple quick q's: which quant profile (int8/int4)? warmup strategy details? pin to a specific kernel build? any latency SLO or cost target? ETA you need artifacts by?

lia (marketing): use int8 with qkv-fuse enabled. warmup: pick 20% of the hotpath cohort and replay once, then each worker does 10 local warmup requests. pin to kernel build `stable-2025-11`. target for hotpath p99 is <=650ms. artifacts needed EOD Fri.

mike: reproducibility note — use seed=42. example run we use in infra (drop-in):

```
curl -X POST https://runtime.internal/redwood/v1/bench \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"llama-13b-v1-int8","batch_profile":"restricted","requests_file":"/tmp/requests.json","seed":42}'
```

Also include `sha256` for `/tmp/requests.json` and the exact docker/kernel tag.

emma: infra will reserve the dedicated pool during the window. proposed slot Fri 14:00-16:00 PT. we'll throttle noisy jobs. @runtime-bot will post run-start/run-end. :thumbsup:

runtime-bot: Scheduled test run: job-id r-job-20260325-71. Estimated duration 55m. logs -> https://internal/logs/r-job-20260325-71

suresh: quick smoke log from dev env we want to avoid in prod run — posting so marketing understands variance source:

```
[2026-03-24T18:02:12Z] worker-7 p99=912ms spike req_id=abc123 token_len=4096
  trace: kernel-fallback -> quant-kernel fallback -> conv1
  note: heavy KV-cache miss after a batching burst; observed when warmup omitted for that shard
```

we'll instrument KV hit ratios and per-batch kernel selection in the run artifacts.

lia (marketing): perfect. please attach a 1-paragraph method blurb we can paste into a slide (1-2 sentences on cohort selection + warmup + pinned build), the run command, and the checksums. anonymize any customer payloads; include one anonymized long-context example. if you hit >700ms p99 on hotpath, flag with the primary cause and config we used.

suresh: will do. if artifacts are ready early we'll drop in #marketing; otherwise we'll ping when upload completes. thanks everyone. :pray:
